articles.title: Getting started with SMN
articles.searchText: getting started with smn scrum master notebook helps you follow teams and their agile activities first steps review your installation settings select a team that you are authorized to access use the navigation entries to discover available features this overview does not validate any setup step a detailed first time setup guide will be provided separately

articles.title: Tickets
articles.searchText: tickets the tickets module provides access to features related to csv ticket snapshots access open tickets from the main navigation review the actions available under your account permissions this introduction does not replace the detailed csv import guide which will be written against the implemented behavior
